property_summary: For any asset, after a successful withdrawFees call the recorded unclaimedFees for that asset must be zeroed (fees can only be withdrawn once); the mutant fails to zero it, so after withdrawing fees c.unclaimedFees(asset) stays nonzero for any fillOrder that accrued a fee.
change_summary: Delete the statement that zeroes out unclaimedFees[asset], so fees remain recorded after withdrawal and can be withdrawn repeatedly.
